appDescription.message:
Enhanced bookmark search with omnibox integration! Type 'bm' in the address bar followed by your search term to quickly find and navigate to bookmarks.

Features:
• Omnibox search: Type 'bm <query>' in address bar
• Auto-suffix bookmarks with folder/domain/path info
• Toggle suffix mode with extension button

F=Folder, D=Domain, P=Path

Icon by Nimal Raj from Noun Project
